description: This file defines a React functional component named ModelAliasManager, which manages a list of model aliases including adding, editing, deleting, and displaying a configuration example. It uses React hooks and external components for UI elements.

methods.name: handleAddAlias
methods.description: Handles adding a new alias after validation, updates state, and notifies parent component.

methods.name: handleEditAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias to be edited.

methods.name: handleUpdateAlias
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing alias, updating state and notifying parent.

methods.name: deleteAlias
methods.description: Deletes an alias by ID, updates state, and notifies parent.
